method: Snowflake tweet timestamps are decoded with epoch 1288834974657; article timestamps come from retained JSON-LD. The source page was copied locally with its original bytes and hash.

entries.headline: Thunder announce Chet Holmgren pelvic fracture

primaryEvidence.evidence: The retained NBA News Services page states that the team announced the right iliac wing fracture and expected return this season.

independentSocialCorroboration.text: Per the Thunder, Chet Holmgren suffered a right iliac wing fracture on Sunday night. He’s expected to return this season, and a status update will be provided in 8-10 weeks.
independentSocialCorroboration.role: Secondary reporter contemporaneous corroboration; later than the retained article publication.

entries.limitation: The linked team page was not independently retrievable in this environment, so the cutoff uses the retained NBA article's JSON-LD publication instant rather than claiming an earlier team-post time.

entries.headline: Chet Holmgren announces return

primaryEvidence.role: Player's own announcement, embedded by the contemporaneous NBA/AP article.

independentArticleCorroboration.evidence: The article reports the return announcement and embeds the player's tweet; its later game recap is not used as the event headline.

entries.limitation: The announcement is scored at the player's tweet timestamp; the February 7 Toronto game is a separate later result and is excluded from this event.
